report_description: Exports the result of a run: JSON (result.json itself) or SARIF 2.1.0 (only the compatible findings).
report_option_out: Output file (without this option, the document goes to standard output).
report_option_agent_context: Produces the safe summary for a coding agent (frozen policy instruction, delimited data, reproduction command). Sends nothing.
report_missing_run_fix: Use: jgates report <runId> [--format json|sarif] [--out <file>]. See the ids with jgates history.
report_run_not_found: Run not found in this workspace: {runId}
report_run_not_found_fix: See the runs with jgates history.
report_unreadable: The result of the run {runId} could not be read.
report_unreadable_fix: The run may have been interrupted or deleted by retention.
report_write_failed_fix: Check the folder and the permissions.
